title: RunSummary.application_drafts_expired field doc still preaches the pre-amendment 'drafts die at vacancy close' semantic
detail: The diff updated the sweep_application_drafts comment (line 308: 'Drafts die 7 days AFTER vacancy close (draft-grace-period amendment)') and both SQL comments, but missed this RunSummary field doc ~200 lines above in the same file, which still states the old close-time deletion semantic the amendment replaced.
recommended_fix: Reword the field doc to match the amendment, e.g. 'F3 application drafts expired on this run (vacancy close older than the 7-day extension grace — draft-grace-period amendment).'
